name: brainstorming
description: Structured approach to brainstorming and design. Guides users through clarifying questions, exploring 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, and validating a design incrementally before any code is written.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborative design dialogue - idea to approaches to design to plan
interface.longDescription: Collaborative design dialogue that turns a rough idea into a validated design: one question at a time, 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, then incremental section-by-section review before handing off to a plan. Supports project and user level custom rules, and ships a PreToolUse hook that prevents the skill from modifying its own files.
defaultPrompt: Use brainstorming to explore approaches for this feature.
Use brainstorming to turn this idea into a design doc.
Use brainstorming to compare implementation directions before I commit to one.
